notes.title: Hellishly small update!
notes.content:
Hello!
I just released a small, hellish update to the game with 1 new weapon. I'll let you discover the new weapon for yourself. :)

notes.title: Bacon Rebellion - Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
Hey!

Thanks to everyone who bought the game so far, it's much appreciated!
I have released a small update to the game, which fixes some small things and adds a little bit of content and QoL changes. 
Hope you enjoy it!
Thanks!

[b]v1.1.1 Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Smaller HP and Stamina bars now show up above the character when HP and Stamina is not at maximum. 
[*] Exploding Barrels - Several exploding barrels are now placed around the level.
[*] Parachuting Barrels - Every now and then a parachute with a barrel drops from the sky, allowing you to explode more.
[*] A Perk that makes barrels fall from the sky more often.
[*] Fixed a small bug with leaderboard entries not displaying correctly.
[/list]
